title: ELEVATE Act of 2025
committees: S-Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-06-24 || H-Financial Services Committee: Referred To 2025-05-08 -> Markup By 2025-05-20 -> Reported By 2025-06-03
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: This bill provides statutory authority for certain requirements related to registration statements submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). First, the bill allows under statute an emerging growth company to submit profit and loss statements from the previous two years, rather than the previous three years as is required of other reporting companies. In addition, the bill allows under statute any issuer of securities to submit a draft registration statement to the SEC for confidential review prior to a public filing.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
